segs.text: There's one marketing habit that quietly kills the blessing in your sales.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, warned about exactly this.
If they told lies or hid something, then the blessings of their transaction would be lost.
The sale might still go through.
But the barakah leaves with it.
Show the real product, the real process, and the real results.
Clear, true content builds trust. And trust is what turns a viewer into a customer.
Save this for the next time you write a launch post.
